[[File:Qixonicrystal.jpg|thumb|right|A Qixoni crystal.]]

'''Qixoni crystals''' were exceedingly rare [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] of a dark red color.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> They required the user to be firmly aligned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to efficiently use it in a weapon.<ref name="TSL" /> 

==Description==
The crystal was said to enhance one's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]], in addition to enhancing the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade's power to a significant degree.<ref name="TSL" />

==History==
These unique, powerful gems were formed when a [[Unidentified planet (Qixoni crystals)|planet]] was consumed as its [[Star/Legends|star]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], millennia before the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The heat and energy of the star caused metals and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] in the planet to become fused into [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] which was then blasted into the [[Qixoni Nebula/Legends|Qixoni Nebula]] when the planet was destroyed.<ref name="TSL" />

Those few Qixoni crystals that were obtained by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were discovered to make powerful lightsaber focusing crystals.<ref name="TSL" />

During the [[First Jedi Purge]], [[Sakarie]] offered a Qixoni crystal to the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] in exchange for a [[starport visa]] in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="TSL" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A known crystal mine was in the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] on Dagobah, where [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] got his in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
Despite being non-[[canon]], the player has the option to trade a [[starport visa]] for a Qixoni crystal from [[Sakarie]], earning [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points. The story of the Qixoni crystals can be told by one of the following [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile's]] companions: [[Visas Marr]], [[Mical|Disciple]], [[Brianna|Handmaiden]] or [[Kreia]]; but only if one of them is present in the current party.

A lightsaber with the Qixoni crystal in it can only be equipped by a dark side-aligned character. However, you can overcome this by using the [[Meetra Surik Crystal|Jedi Exile's Crystal]] found on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to allow you to use it as a light sided character. You can also use the [[Solari crystal/Legends|Solari]] crystal in place of the Exile's Crystal.
